surfaces.part: debris clusters (rusty sheet, concrete lumps, glass shards, cable) scattered on the ground

answer.evidence: The silhouette is a full 64-wide rectangle across all 48 rows, a ground patch of mottled brown earth seen from above. The column scans show only mottled earth tones with no front-edge line, eave shadow or vertical front face. Small debris clusters (sheet, concrete, glass) are scattered on it as flat clutter. This is a flat ground decal with no front face, which suits the kind 'flat'.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has 6 visible tones per tile, between the grass reference (3) and the paving reference (7). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no 5x5 flat fills. The soil is mottled with darker clumps and lighter grains in about 4 brown steps. The debris props (rust sheet, concrete, shards) are small and carry their own highlight, mid and dark tones. Only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted dark brown or rust rather than a black sticker line. Weaknesses: the soil ramp is a little shallower than Beodeul's 5-6 steps, the debris clusters look somewhat stamped and repeated, and the oil stain is subtle. Overall it is comparable in density and craft to the references.
